plain: Pulled away or made distant; no longer close or friendly

example.quote: Should it be oppressive, their affections will be totally estranged from it ; and, sir, you know that a government, without their affections, can neither be durable nor happy.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 5, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
